text: Ok so who was it
Morning to you too
You sent me "I did a thing" and then a thumbs up. That's not a full sentence luke
Its not that deep
It's deep enough that you didn't say anything for 3 days
Her name's Nadia. She came in sat w her sister, sister was the one who wanted to stay for last call
Ok good
And then???
And then we went back to hers. Ur not getting more than that
Wait is this the one with the tattoo on her wrist
How do u know about the wrist
You described it to me in october when you thought she was cute and didn't know her name yet
Ok yes
Ok so was it good
Priya
I'm a paramedic I've heard everything, you can't shock me
It was good. Thats all ur getting
That is not all I'm getting, that is the first half of the story
Im on break, im eating a sad sandwich
I'm on a 12 hour shift and just ate a granola bar in the ambulance. We're both having a bad lunch
Ur not allowed to complain about ur lunch, u get paid to save people
Ok so about dani's thing
Oh right the birthday
Thursday dinner or friday? I'm off thurs but not till 7pm if I pick up the extra
Thurs works. I close fri so thurs is better anyway
Ok so dinner thursday, I'll find a place that takes a group. Brunch sunday for the people who can't do thursday?
Sunday works. Ill ask dani if shes ok w that
She'll say yes, she always says yes to brunch
Ok ill text her. Nadia wants to get brunch sunday too lol
Luke
Dont she's not coming. She has a thing with her sister
I didn't say anything
Ur whole face said it
Off shift. I smell like a hospital hallway and I want to be asleep
U say that like its new
Ok but so did you ask her out or is this a one time situation
Idk. We texted sunday morning. She said she had a good time
And?
And I said me too. Then she didn't text for like 4 hours and I was convinced I'd screwed it up
And she was just at work
Yeah she was at work. I know that now 🙃
I'm so proud of you for texting her back in under 4 hours
Go to sleep priya
Going. Don't do anything dumb with her texts
Too late for that one
LUKE
Kidding. She sent a picture of her cat. Im in love
Morning. Did you sleep or did you stare at the cat picture all night
Slept. Some
Her cat's name is Pickle
Ok that's a good name
Is she sending you cat pics or is that a thing now
Its a thing now. Im not even mad about it
I'm not going to say anything about that
Ok I said something
[photo: Pickle asleep in a laundry basket]
Ok that cat is living its best life
Off today, I'm going to the store for literally one thing and I'm going to come home with four
Are we doing the restaurant for thurs or just picking one from the list
Picking. I have three options I like. The Polish place on Milwaukee takes groups but they want a deposit
The other two are the taco place and the one in Andersonville w the big table in back
Andersonville. Dani likes the candles
She likes everything with candles. Ok I'll call
Can I ask u something and u dont make a face
I can't see your face Luke
Is it weird to invite nadia to dani's thing
Yes
You've known her for 3 days. Dani doesn't know her. You'd be bringing a date to a birthday dinner for a person who has no idea who she is
Ok but its brunch sunday not the dinner
Still weird
Ok
Ur not gonna say anything else
I said weird, that's the whole thing
Shes not coming in tonight. I'm at the bar and its dead. Two guys and a guy who wants to talk about the bears
Sorry. Hope the bears guy tips
Did she say anything about tonight
She said she had a late thing with her sister
Idk. Is that a no
I don't know Luke. I've only heard about her from you
Fair
Did you text her back or are you still deciding
Don't answer that, I can tell from here
Shes coming by after her shift. Like 1 maybe
Luke. It's a Tuesday
Im aware of the day
Ok. Text me when you're home. Not because I'm worried. Because I want the details
Ur such a liar
Morning. Still waiting on the text from last night
I said text when you're home. I did not say text when you've decided to stop talking to me
Home. Shes asleep. Dont make me talk about it
Ok so yes
Its a "I'm not talking about it" yes
Fine. Did she leave Pickle with you or is the cat at her place
Pickle's at her place. Im not sure I'm ready for that level of commitment
Ok I called the Andersonville place
They have the big table in back Thurs at 7. They want a card on file for 8 or more, no deposit under 10
So we're 8 if Dani's coworker comes. Otherwise we're 7 and it's free
Ill ask Marcus. He's coming. He just doesn't know it yet
Ok I'll put the card down as 8 and we don't pay the deposit either way
Don't make me pay for Marcus
Marcus will pay for himself. Hes a good guy
Sunday brunch. Dani said yes to brunch, she said "of course, I always say yes to brunch." She did not say which place. I'm thinking the one by the lake that's always a 40 min wait
Nadia asked if she could come to brunch Sunday
I said I'd ask. I'm asking
Luke
I know
It's Dani's birthday brunch. Ask Dani. Don't ask me to be the one who says no
Ok. I'll ask Dani
Ur going to be so mad when she says yes
I will be mad about a lot of things and that's one of them
Going to nap. Don't text Nadia about me
Wouldn't dream of it
Dani said yes to Nadia. She said "the more the merrier, tell her to bring a plate"
Oh no
Shes coming to the bar at 10 to watch the game. Dont say anything
I'm not saying anything. I'm just going to be on the couch with my eyes closed, thinking about it
